statements.status_notes: PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-6472 (PostgreSQL CREATE TYPE does not check multirange schema CREATE privilege) in 17.10 on the PostgreSQL 17 branch: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-6472/ lists 17.10 as the fixed release for major version 17, and the 17.10 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/17.10/, list this CVE. The fix is commit https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/c27ba08cd5c58659b32805fe807683cde5429ab2 on the REL_17_STABLE branch, 'Check CREATE privilege on multirange type schema in CREATE TYPE.', which changes src/backend/commands/typecmds.c; it is tagged Security: CVE-2026-6472, and it is in the REL_17_10 release tag and not in REL_17_9. The affected code is in the PostgreSQL server, /usr/libexec/postgresql17/postgres, in the postgresql17 package, in every published build on both architectures. The DHI postgresql17 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from Alpine's postgresql17 APKBUILD, currently https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/ce22298320177ae25085d86fbf3b4fc1150c16a2/main/postgresql17/APKBUILD, which builds the upstream PostgreSQL release tarball; none of the patches it applies, in this or the earlier revisions the published builds came from, touch the source files this fix changes. We checked every published postgresql17 build for Alpine 3.23 (17.7-r0, 17.8-r0, 17.9-r0, 17.10-r0, 17.11-r0 and 17.12-r0) on both x86_64 and aarch64, with package checksums verified against the package index: the server binary of each build reports the PostgreSQL release of the same version (17.7, 17.8, 17.9, 17.10, 17.11 and 17.12). Of these, 17.10-r0, 17.11-r0 and 17.12-r0 carry the fix, and 17.7-r0, 17.8-r0 and 17.9-r0 are affected. This fix adds no distinctive message string or symbol, so the per-build evidence is the version each server binary reports. 17.10-r0 is the first published build for Alpine 3.23 that carries the fix. Alpine's postgresql17 APKBUILD lists CVE-2026-6472 under its 17.10-r0 secfixes.
